patterns.message: Import design-system components from the bundle namespace, not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a Lumenis color token via var() (primary: --lumenis-black / --lumenis-white; one --sb-* secondary per view).

no-restricted-syntax.selector: Literal[value=/font-family\s*:\s*(?!['\"]?(?:ABC Arizona Sans|ABC Arizona Mix|Arial|Noto Sans Hebrew|Noto Sans TC|Noto Serif SC))/i]
no-restricted-syntax.message: Font not provided by the design system. Available: ABC Arizona Sans, ABC Arizona Mix (highlight only), Arial (system fallback), Noto Sans Hebrew, Noto Sans CJK TC / Noto Serif SC.
Lumenis surfaces and CTAs are square — use --radius-none.
Brand rule: 0 tracking at every level.
The Lumenis wordmark is black or white only — never colored.
<Icon> name must be one of the 10 brand line illustrations.
